captions.caption: A man walks through a dense, foggy jungle.
The man continues walking, carrying a large leaf.
The man walks toward the camera in the mist.
The man enters a bamboo structure from the forest.
The man walks into the hut carrying a small animal.
The man stands inside the hut near a fire.
The man examines a small rodent he caught.
The man holds up the rodent for the camera.
The man cleans the rodent near the fire.
The man continues handling the rodent inside the hut.
The man prepares to cook the rodent over the fire.
Close-up of the man's hands tending the fire.
The man uses sticks to adjust logs in the fire.
The man blows on embers to start the fire.
The man adds small pieces of wood to the fire.
The man nurtures the small fire in the hut.
Flames grow as the man adds more fuel.
The man adjusts burning sticks in the fire pit.
The man uses a bamboo tube to blow on the fire.
The man stokes flames through the bamboo tube.
The fire burns brighter as air is added.
The man continues using the tube to maintain the fire.
The man sets down the tube and watches the fire.
A steady fire burns on the dirt floor.
The man prepares to leave the hut for resources.
The man stands up and moves away from the fire.
The man exits the hut into the foggy forest.
The man walks through dense vegetation outside.
The man approaches a tree stump in the forest.
The man bends down to pick up a pot.
The man picks up a small pot and examines it.
The man pours liquid between containers.
The man transfers liquid carefully near the tree.
The man uses a large leaf to cover a container.
The man adjusts the leaf cover on his pot.
The man works diligently in the foggy jungle.
The man picks up a large green leaf.
The man inspects the leaf before using it.
The man places the leaf over a bamboo container.
The man pours more liquid into a metal pot.
Liquid is collected from the base of a tree.
The man continues harvesting in the forest.
The man checks the contents of the pot.
The man uses a leaf to cover the work area.
The man picks up a smaller container from the ground.
The man pours liquid from bamboo into the pot.
The man finishes filling the pot with liquid.
The man stands up and prepares to carry the pot.
The man picks up the pot and supplies.
The man walks back toward his shelter in fog.
The man navigates through the forest floor.
The man stops to adjust his gear.
The man squats to work on something on the ground.
The man prepares materials for his next task.
The man stands and moves through the brush.
The man disappears into the thick jungle fog.
The scene cuts back to the hut interior.
The man is back inside tending the fire.
The man places the rodent over the fire.
The man begins roasting the rodent over flames.
